onepager.title: AI 보조기구 확산과 온디바이스 AI 성능 향상
onepager.sourceLine: 최근 여러 기업들이 AI 보조기구를 확장하며 시장 점유율을 높이고자 하는 전략을 세우고 있음.
onepager.scope: 스마트폰, 태블릿, 웨어러블 기기, 서비스 수익화
onepager.thesis: AI 보조기구의 성장은 온디바이스 AI 성능 향상과 함께 경쟁력 강화의 기회를 제공한다.

insights.title: AI 보조기구의 사용자 접근성 증가
insights.body: AI 보조기구의 제공 범위가 확대됨에 따라 사용자 수가 증가할 것으로 예상된다. 이는 서비스 성과 개선으로 이어져 경쟁력을 강화할 가능성이 있다.

insights.title: 효율적인 온디바이스 AI 성능 향상
insights.body: AI 보조기구로 인해 온디바이스 AI의 성능이 향상될 수 있다. 이는 사용자 경험 개선과 연계되어 시장 점유율 확대에 기여할 것이다.

insights.title: AI 기술의 경제적 가치 증대
insights.body: AI 조기 도입으로 인해 기업의 운영 효율성이 개선되고 있으며, 이는 서비스 수익화와 직결된다. AI 투자에 대한 긍정적인 결과가 기대된다.

insights.title: 경쟁사 대응 전략 필요성
insights.body: AI 보조기구에 대한 대응 전략이 필요하다. 경쟁사와의 차별화를 통해 시장에서의 위치를 더욱 강화할 수 있다.

metrics.t: AI 모델 및 플랫폼 시장 규모 예상
AI 플랫폼 및 모델 시장 성장률
CFO들이 AI 투자의 생산성 향상 경향

implications.text: 온디바이스 AI와 연결된 서비스 모델 개발이 필요하다.
AI 효율성을 높이기 위한 부품 조달 전략 강화가 필수적이다.
패러다임 변화에 맞춘 경쟁 전략 수립이 필요하다.
AI 기술을 접목한 혁신적인 제품 개발이 중요하다.

onepager.conclusion: AI 보조기구의 확산은 단말 사업의 성과에 긍정적인 영향을 미칠 것으로 예상된다. 온디바이스 AI의 성능 향상은 경쟁력을 높이는 핵심 요소가 될 것이다.
onepager.watch: AI 관련 규제가 기업의 혁신과 경제성에 미치는 영향을 면밀히 검토해야 한다.

feed.title: Investors Matter for the Future of Trustworthy AI. Are they ready?
feed.desc: Investors Matter for the Future of Trustworthy AI. Are they ready?    OECD AI Policy Observatory

sourceContent.headline: Investors Matter for the Future of Trustworthy AI. Are they ready?
sourceContent.description: Investors are beginning to treat trustworthy AI not as a niche governance issue but as a material business factor.
paragraphs: Investors see AI trustworthiness as financially material At the GPAI Expert Group on Trustworthy AI Investment meeting, held on 11 June 2026, one message emerged clearly from discussions across public and private markets: investors no longer view trustworthy AI as a purely ethical consideration.

The GPAI Expert Group on Trustworthy AI Investment wants to help bridge this gap by examining how investors can help advance trustworthy AI by integrating governance, accountability and risk management considerations into investment decisions.

But when investment committees sit down to make decisions, they often lack the common language, data, tools, experience, and signals needed to translate trustworthiness, as reflected in the OECD AI Principles, into something they can evaluate and act on.
sourceContent.text:
Investors see AI trustworthiness as financially material At the GPAI Expert Group on Trustworthy AI Investment meeting, held on 11 June 2026, one message emerged clearly from discussions across public and private markets: investors no longer view trustworthy AI as a purely ethical consideration.

The GPAI Expert Group on Trustworthy AI Investment wants to help bridge this gap by examining how investors can help advance trustworthy AI by integrating governance, accountability and risk management considerations into investment decisions.

But when investment committees sit down to make decisions, they often lack the common language, data, tools, experience, and signals needed to translate trustworthiness, as reflected in the OECD AI Principles, into something they can evaluate and act on.

localization.title: 신뢰할 수 있는 AI의 미래에는 투자자가 중요함 · 준비됐나요
summaryLines: 투자자들은 AI 신뢰성을 재정적으로 중요한 요소로 보고 있음 · 2026년 6월 11일에 개최된 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 투자에 관한 GPAI 전문가 그룹 회의에서 공공 및 민간 시장 전반의 논의에서 한 가지 메시지가 분명하게 나타남 · 즉, 투자자들은 더 이상 신뢰할 수 있는 AI를 순전히 윤리적인 고려 사항으로 보지 않는다는 것임
신뢰할 수 있는 AI 투자에 관한 GPAI 전문가 그룹은 투자자가 거버넌스, 책임 및 위험 관리 고려 사항을 투자 결정에 통합하여 신뢰할 수 있는 AI를 발전시키는 데 어떻게 도움을 줄 수 있는지 검토함으로써 이러한 격차를 해소하는 데 도움을 주고자 함
그러나 투자위원회가 결정을 내릴 때 OECD AI 원칙에 반영된 신뢰성을 평가하고 조치할 수 있는 것으로 변환하는 데 필요한 공통 언어, 데이터, 도구, 경험 및 신호가 부족한 경우가 많음

summaryLinesEn: Bank of America (BAC) stock closed at $54.32 on October 9, gaining 1.32% after a prolonged decline.

Investment banking fees expected to decline at least 10% Bank of America’s Q2 earnings provide a strong comparison Bank of America (NYSE: BAC) enters the week of October 12 with its consumer banking and lending operations providing support for earnings, even as investment banking activity slows following an exceptionally strong second quarter.
Noninterest expenses totaled $18.6 bn, increasing 8% year over year, with spending driven by revenue-related costs and investments in employees, technology and the bank’s brand.

summaryLinesEn: The JPMorgan Core Plus Bond Fund ETF is down more than 5% so far this year as of Friday's close, according to FactSet.

feed.titleEn: Competition Among China’s AI Models Is Intensifying as the Chip Sector Advances
feed.descEn: Investors are debating how the landscape for AI-model companies will evolve as competition intensifies.
summaryLinesEn: China’s semiconductor sector is ramping up faster than the market expected, though bottlenecks persist.

The competition between makers of China’s artificial intelligence (AI) models is intensifying, raising questions among investors on the sustainability of leadership in model performance, with increasing focus on cost efficiencies and the harness layer.
The event featured companies that form the entire AI supply chain: 400 companies were represented and over 1,400 investors attended the event in Hong Kong.

feed.titleEn: Becamex IDC approved 200-home sale: what it means for Becamex IDC stock
feed.descEn: For Becamex IDC stock, the deal means VND 1.012 trillion in contracts. MBS forecasts VND 3,970 billion profit for 2026.
summaryLinesEn: Becamex IDC (ISIN VN000000BCM3) had approved the sale of 200 Green City homes for VND 1.012 trillion on September 29, 2026, creating a concrete property transaction for the industrial real estate group.
For Becamex IDC stock, the deal means VND 1.012 trillion in contracts.
The transaction is a related-party deal because Becamex holds 49.76 percent of Becamex IJC, according to the same September 29 report from Tin nhanh chung khoan .

feed.title: CEPAL continúa en Santiago con agenda sobre integración
feed.desc: CEPAL continúa este jueves en Santiago mesas de trabajo sobre integración regional, inteligencia artificial y desarrollo    De Último Minuto
feed.titleEn: CEPAL continúa en Santiago con agenda sobre integración
feed.descEn: La CEPAL continúa en Santiago su 41.º período de sesiones con debates sobre integración regional, inteligencia artificial y desarrollo productivo.
summaryLinesEn: Santiago. — Las actividades del 41.º Período de Sesiones de la CEPAL continúan este jueves en Santiago con una agenda centrada en los principales desafíos y oportunidades que enfrenta América Latina y el Caribe ante la nueva realidad geopolítica, tecnológica y económica.

Recomendamos leer: CEPAL coloca a Santiago y al Cibao en el centro del desarrollo económico de República Dominicana, afirma Andrés Cueto Posteriormente, a las 4:30 de la tarde, será abordada la transformación digital, la inteligencia artificial y el desarrollo productivo, con la participación de funcionarios, especialistas y representantes de organismos internacionales.

A partir de las 2:30 de la tarde, se desarrollará el seminario de alto nivel con la Mesa 1, titulada “Una nueva etapa en la integración regional: qué hacer y cómo avanzar”, con representantes de Barbados, Brasil, México, CARICOM, SICA y el sector empresarial dominicano.

localization.title: ECLAC는 통합에 관한 의제를 가지고 산티아고에서 계속됨
summaryLines: 산티아고 · — ECLAC 제41차 회의 활동은 새로운 지정학적, 기술적, 경제적 현실에 직면하여 라틴 아메리카와 카리브해 지역이 직면한 주요 과제와 기회에 초점을 맞춘 의제를 바탕으로 이번 주 목요일 산티아고에서 계속됨
다음을 읽어 보시기 바람 · ECLAC는 산티아고와 시바오를 도미니카 공화국의 경제 발전의 중심에 두고 있다고 Andrés Cueto는 말함 · 나중에 오후 4시 30분에는 관료, 전문가 및 국제기구 대표가 참여하여 디지털 변혁, 인공 지능 및 생산적 개발에 대해 논의할 것임
오후 2시 30분부터 바베이도스, 브라질, 멕시코, CARICOM, SICA, 도미니카 기업계 대표들이 참석해 '지역 통합의 새로운 단계 · 무엇을 해야 하고 어떻게 전진할 것인가'라는 제목의 고위급 세미나가 표 1에서 진행됨

paragraphs: Democratic Values, Honors Community Leaders Maryland Hosts Inaugural South Asian American Health Summit Indian Food and Agri Exporters Meet Australian Buyers in Sydney and Melbourne Anita Anand’s India, UAE Visit to Focus on Trade and Security Roots and Rights: For Indian Families, Germany’s Study Option Adds Up Save my name, email, and website in this browser for the next time I comment.

“Achieving universal meaningful connectivity will require an estimated USD 2.6-2.8 trillion by 2030, including USD 1.5-1.7 trillion for digital infrastructure, with much of the gap concentrated in the Global South.”

In an exclusive interview with South Asian Herald’s Rajesh Mehta, International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Deputy Secretary-General Tomas Lamanauskas discusses India’s growing role in global digital cooperation, the Indian diaspora’s contributions to innovation, and efforts to bridge the digital divide across the Global South.

Lamanauskas also examines the risk of a “digital pandemic,” the resilience of critical communications infrastructure, and the need to ensure that artificial intelligence advances sustainable development while benefiting communities worldwide.

For Lamanauskas, the UN remains indispensable in addressing challenges that transcend national borders. “The UN remains essential for cooperation on shared global challenges. Digital technologies alone can support progress on at least 70% of the 169 SDG targets, making digital cooperation critical to the 2030 Agenda.”

summaryLines: 민주적 가치, 지역 사회 지도자 표창 메릴랜드, 남아시아계 미국인 건강 서밋 최초 개최 인도 식품 및 농업 수출업체가 시드니와 멜버른에서 호주 구매자를 만나 무역 및 안보 뿌리와 권리에 초점을 맞추기 위한 아니타 아난드(Anita Anand)의 인도, 아랍에미리트 방문 · 인도 가족을 위한 독일의 연구 옵션이 추가됨 다음에 댓글을 작성할 때 내 이름, 이메일, 웹사이트를 이 브라우저에 저장하세요
“보편적이고 의미 있는 연결성을 달성하려면 2030년까지 디지털 인프라에 1조 5~1조 7천억 달러를 포함해 약 2조 6천억~2조 8천억 달러가 필요할 것으로 예상되며, 그 격차는 대부분 남반구에 집중되어 있음”

"디지털 경제는 대체로 눈에 보이지 않는 인프라에 달려 있음 · 모바일 광대역은 현재 전 세계 인구의 96% 이상을 커버하고 있음 · 19,000개 이상의 위성이 지구 궤도를 돌고 있음 · 10여 년 전 약 1,000개에 비해 데이터 센터는 2025년 전 세계 신규 투자 가치의 5분의 1 이상을 차지함 · 앞서 언급했듯이 해저 케이블은 국제 데이터 트래픽의 99% 이상을 전달함"

feed.titleEn: 【解説】総務省がe-StatのAI対応改修に7億円を概算要求、MCP実装と報道
feed.descEn: 総務省は2027年度予算の概算要求で、政府統計の窓口e-StatのAI対応改修に7.0億円を求めた。10月5日の読売新聞はMCPでの実装と開発費1.6億円を報じたが、概算要求の資料に方式名はない。民間のMCPサーバやデジタル庁の先行例と並べ、国の統計の窓口がAIを迎える意味を読み解く。
summaryLinesEn: 資料が掲げる目的は、統計データの利活用や高度な利用へのニーズが一段と高まっていることへの対応です。
そのための手段として、AIが統計データを円滑に取得できるようにするデータ提供の見直しと、最新技術を使った検索性の強化が挙げられています。
主な経費として、政府統計共同利用システム整備経費5.5億円（新規）と、統計基盤デジタル化推進等経費1.6億円を挙げる。

新社会システム総合研究所(SSK)は、1996年12月6日に設立、創業以来28年以上 法人向けビジネスセミナーを年間約500回企画開催する情報提供サービスを主な事業としております。

feed.title: Governing with agentic AI: when machines act on government’s behalf
feed.desc: Governing with agentic AI: when machines act on government’s behalf    OECD AI Policy Observatory
feed.titleEn: Governing with agentic AI: when machines act on government’s behalf
feed.descEn: Agentic AI raises new questions about how governments can maintain standards of safe, secure and trustworthy AI while machines act on their behalf.
summaryLinesEn: It works through four dimensions, (1) assessing risks and limiting what an agent may do up front; (2) keeping humans meaningfully accountable; (3) putting technical controls in place; and (4) enabling end-user responsibility.

To help answer these questions, a new Working Group on Agentic AI in Government, has been established at the OECD under the Working Party of Senior Digital Government Officials (E-Leaders) with a goal to seek to understand what governing with agentic AI should look like in practice, building on the OECD’s existing work on the agentic AI landscape .
Nearly all OECD governments have adopted AI to help meet these expectations, and the OECD’s 2025 Governing with AI report set out the current state of play across core government functions.

localization.title: 에이전트 AI를 사용한 통치 · 기계가 정부를 대신하여 행동하는 경우
summaryLines: 이는 4가지 차원을 통해 작동함 · (1) 위험을 평가하고 상담원이 사전에 수행할 수 있는 작업을 제한함 · (2) 인간에게 의미 있는 책임을 부여하는 것; (3) 기술적 통제를 마련함 · (4) 최종 사용자의 책임을 활성화함
이러한 질문에 대한 답변을 돕기 위해, 에이전트 AI 환경에 대한 OECD의 기존 작업을 기반으로 에이전트 AI를 사용한 통치가 실제로 어떤 모습이어야 하는지 이해하고자 하는 목표로 OECD의 고위 디지털 정부 공무원 작업반(E-Leaders) 산하의 에이전트 AI에 대한 새로운 실무 그룹이 OECD에 설립됨
거의 모든 OECD 정부는 이러한 기대를 충족하기 위해 AI를 채택했으며, OECD의 2025년 AI 거버넌스 보고서는 핵심 정부 기능 전반에 걸친 현재 활동 상태를 설명함

feed.title: BofA unpacks the threat Meta's Muse poses to banks
feed.desc: 'A multiyear evolutionary risk': BofA unpacks the threat Meta's Muse poses to banks    Business Insider
feed.titleEn: BofA unpacks the threat Meta's Muse poses to banks
feed.descEn: Banks make a lot of money from people leaving cash idle in low-yielding accounts, but those days could be coming to an end thanks to agentic AI.
summaryLinesEn: According to a study from Bankrate, $10,000 earning 4% per year would earn $2,167 over a five-year period, while one would earn just $5 over that time at a 0.01% interest rate.

In a client note on Wednesday, BofA said agentic AI assistants like Meta's Muse — which can perform tasks autonomously, including making purchases and dealing with account admin— pose a "multiyear evolutionary risk" to banks' business models.
This way, BofA said, the banks can at least keep the money in-house with their own investment products.

paragraphs: According to a study from Bankrate, $10,000 earning 4% per year would earn $2,167 over a five-year period, while one would earn just $5 over that time at a 0.01% interest rate.

In a client note on Wednesday, BofA said agentic AI assistants like Meta's Muse — which can perform tasks autonomously, including making purchases and dealing with account admin— pose a "multiyear evolutionary risk" to banks' business models.
This way, BofA said, the banks can at least keep the money in-house with their own investment products.

feed.descEn: Steve Magill explores where AI may create durable value, and where the narrative may be moving faster than fundamentals.
summaryLinesEn: 1 Big Tech to Spend USD 650 Billion This Year as AI Race Intensifies, Bloomberg, Feb 6, 2026 and Charted: The USD 448B AI Spending Surge by Big Tech, Visual Capitalist, Apr 20, 2026.

2 While AI adoption curves will vary by industry, we expect this technology to become universally embedded in digital workflows, in much the same way the internet moved from a standalone product to invisible infrastructure within two decades.

Applications range from accelerating revenue growth and improving pricing to personalizing offerings, optimizing supply chains and structurally reducing costs – in each case, AI functions as a margin and productivity lever rather than a product in itself.

feed.titleEn: Morgan Stanley says AI agents could boost, not threaten, call-center firms
feed.descEn: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley said in a note Wednesday that the rise of consumer AI agents such as Meta’s Muse could benefit communications and software vendors long seen as vulnerable to automation, rather than threaten them.
summaryLinesEn: This AI enabler is up 90%+ since picked by our AI models in July -- and still has a 62% upside » Suddenly, These ‘AI-Proof Stocks’ Are Anything But Barrons.com • 19d ago META NFLX Meta’s AI Agent for Consumers Has Arrived.

Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley said in a note Wednesday that the rise of consumer AI agents such as Meta's Muse could benefit communications and software vendors long seen as vulnerable to automation, rather than threaten them.

"Consumer agents lower the effort required to engage a business, while enterprise AI lowers the cost of responding, potentially expanding communications volumes and usage-based monetization," she wrote.

feed.desc: A Competitive Differentiator    Citigroup

sourceContent.headline: A Competitive Differentiator
sourceContent.description: Citi, the leading global bank, serves more than 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Learn more today.
paragraphs: In fact, employees have interacted with the firm’s AI tools more than 65 million times since the internal AI rollout began in December 2024, with a total adoption rate of more than 87%.

In the realm of agentic AI, Citi introduced Arc in April 2026 to deploy embedded AI agents across every business line, geography and function — all with the same rigor and control applied to any critical system within the firm.
Scaling AI across the firm is “a highly commercial endeavor,” David says, increasing efficiency and creating new products to generate more revenue.
David Griffiths, Citi’s Group Head of AI, drives the firmwide strategy to embed AI across a global systemically important bank that moves nearly $6 trillion daily

From the Arc agent platform to a proprietary suite of AI tools (Citi AI) and a wealth management assistant (Citi Sky), Citi’s sophisticated AI ecosystem helps serve clients, generate revenue and gain wallet share
Key relationships with top-tier industry players — including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and Microsoft — position Citi as the bank to define the next era of financial services
sourceContent.text:
In fact, employees have interacted with the firm’s AI tools more than 65 million times since the internal AI rollout began in December 2024, with a total adoption rate of more than 87%.

In the realm of agentic AI, Citi introduced Arc in April 2026 to deploy embedded AI agents across every business line, geography and function — all with the same rigor and control applied to any critical system within the firm.

sourceContent.headline: Learnings from Earnings
sourceContent.description: Global strength defined the 2Q 2026 earnings season as earnings growth broadened, execution drove dispersion, and AI investment gained traction.
paragraphs: Adjusted S&P 500 earnings growth reached 32% year-over-year, supported by continued strength in AI infrastructure spending.

In the US, adjusted earnings growth exceeded 30%, revenue growth accelerated to its strongest pace in four years, and the vast majority of companies delivered earnings and revenue ahead of expectations.
Across major indices, returns were largely driven by earnings growth as many of these markets experienced valuation contractions over the quarter.

The second-quarter earnings season was one of the strongest in recent years. Adjusted S&P 500 earnings growth reached 32% year-over-year, supported by continued strength in AI infrastructure spending. Positive surprises were exceptionally broad, with more than 85% of companies exceeding earnings expectations and roughly 70% surpassing revenue forecasts. 1 Strength extended beyond AI-related infrastructure beneficiaries and into consumer, industrial, infrastructure, healthcare, and technology-related end markets.

Worldwide, we have witnessed one of the strongest earnings seasons in recent history. The robustness has been rooted in fundamental earnings delivery rather than expanding market multiples, reflecting healthy corporate profitability across regions. Across major indices, returns were largely driven by earnings growth as many of these markets experienced valuation contractions over the quarter. The strongest returns over the last year have come from Japan, Asia Pacific, and emerging markets, where earnings growth, rather than valuation expansion, accounted for the majority of shareholder returns. With the cost of capital remaining structurally higher, earnings growth is increasingly becoming the primary driver of returns across markets.
Source: Factset, Datastream, STOXX, Goldman Sachs Global Investment Research. As of August 31, 2026. For illustrative purposes only.

sourceContent.headline: Smartphone Shipments Set for Record 16.7% Drop in 2026, as the Memory Crisis Hits Full Force
sourceContent.description: IDC forecasts a record 16.7% smartphone shipment decline in 2026 as the memory crisis pushes ASPs up 27.6% to $581. See who wins and who doesn't.
paragraphs: According to IDC’s Worldwide Quarterly Mobile Phone Tracker , worldwide smartphone shipments will fall 16.7% in 2026 to just over 1 billion units.
Total market value will still grow 6.3% to $613 billion, because higher prices are now doing the heavy lifting that volume once did.
The memory shortage , which started in late 2025, is striking hard in the second half of 2026, with shipments forecast to drop by 27.2% YoY.

sourceContent.description: Bloomberg notes that IDC has a bullish outlook on the device’s performance during its first year. Here are the details.
paragraphs: Despite years-long skepticism around the category, Counterpoint Research recently forecast that book-type devices will account for 76% of global foldable smartphone shipments in 2026, up from 52% in 2025, with Apple’s entry helping drive overall market growth of 21% year over year.
Next month at its “Surprise and shine” event , Apple is widely expected to announce its first book-style foldable iPhone, which rumors say could cost roughly $2,500.

A recent Counterpoint Research report noted that while Samsung led the foldable smartphone market in 2025 with a 40% share, its share is expected to drop to 32% in 2026, with Apple projected to capture 25% of shipments in 2026 alone.

feed.desc: Qatar maintains 98.4 score in ITU's 2026 ICT Development Index    Zawya

sourceContent.headline: Qatar maintains 98.4 score in ITU's 2026 ICT Development Index
sourceContent.description: The achievement reflects Qatar's advanced digital infrastructure, high-quality telecommunications services and sustained digital transformation
paragraphs: The report showed particularly strong performance across several digital connectivity indicators, with Qatar recording a 100% normalized score for individuals using the Internet, households with Internet access at home, mobile broadband subscriptions, and 3G/4G network coverage.

The achievement reflects Qatar's advanced digital infrastructure, high-quality telecommunications services and sustained digital transformation Doha, Qatar: Qatar has maintained a strong position in global digital development, scoring 98.4 out of 100 in the 2026 edition of the International Telecommunication Union’s (ITU) ICT Development Index (IDI).
The score is unchanged from 2025, when Qatar also recorded 98.4, after rising from 97.8 in 2024 and 97.3 in 2023, according to the latest ITU report.

feed.title: Goldman Sachs partner warns of 'huge danger' in letting AI replace bankers' reasoning skills
feed.desc: Goldman Sachs partner warns of 'huge danger' in letting AI replace bankers' reasoning skills    CNBC

sourceContent.headline: Goldman Sachs partner warns of 'huge danger' in letting AI replace bankers' reasoning skills
sourceContent.description: Goldman Sachs is embracing AI, but one of its senior tech leaders warns that it comes with an unintended risk: weakening the reasoning skills of future bankers.
paragraphs: A Goldman Sachs partner leading one of the bank's flagship artificial intelligence projects warned that AI's spread across Wall Street risks hobbling the thinking capabilities of the next generation of financiers.

Even Goldman, one of the world's top investment banks, hasn't yet "figured out" how it will manage the transition the company has begun, said Churchman, who is also co-chair of the firm's Global Banking and Markets AI working group.
Just as people lost navigation and memorization skills with modern inventions, bankers risk losing analytical abilities if algorithms handle all the heavy lifting, Churchman said.

feed.title: JPMorgan says be ready to sell stocks as technical warnings pile up heading into September
feed.desc: JPMorgan says be ready to sell stocks as technical warnings pile up heading into September    Business Insider

sourceContent.headline: JPMorgan says be ready to sell stocks as technical warnings pile up heading into September
sourceContent.description: JPMorgan flagged bearish technical signals flashing in the US market as investors head into what's historically been the weakest period of the year.
paragraphs: Dating back to 1928, the S&P 500 saw an average loss of 0.02% during that period, with the average correction in down years being 7.35%, according to an analysis from Bank of America.

The S&P 500 rallied to a fresh all-time high of 7,816 recently, but has remained well below that range, Hunter said, though he noted that the index remained above its "support zone" of 7,521 to 7,620.

First is the dichotomy between the AI hardware names and the hyperscalers, and the similarities in the market trends that led to the March 2000 peak in the communications equipment capital investment cycle trade theme," Hunter said.
Stocks are still hovering close to record-highs, but a look under the hood of the market shows a more worrying outlook ahead for equities, JPMorgan says.

Jason Hunter, a technical strategist at the bank, said investors may want to consider selling some of their stocks, citing the bank's technical analysis of the S&P 500 and other areas of the US market.
Though major indexes are still "bullishly trending" and haven't flashed "any clear warning signs," the market is flashing several technical signals that suggest stocks could face seasonal weakness.

sourceContent.headline: Rakuten Mobile, Partners Secure ITU-T Standard for Low-Latency AI Networks
sourceContent.description: Rakuten Mobile, Partners Secure ITU-T Standard for Low-Latency AI Networks
paragraphs: He has over 15 years of experience in mobile broadband technologies and solutions, conducting research and analysis on various technology segments and producing articles and write-ups on the latest developments within the sector.

Rakuten Mobile, along with six other leading Japanese telecommunications and technology companies, announced that the framework of low-latency and energy-efficient networks to support the AI era has been approved as an international standard by the International Telecommunication Union Telecommunication Standardization Sector (ITU-T) on August 13, 2026.

Within ITU-T, they are also contributing to the development of a Recommendation on functional architecture for low-latency and energy-efficient networks, targeted for October 2028, and will continue contributing to the global adoption of APN to support the AI era.

This framework will contribute to the realization of All-Photonics Network (APN), a strategic field under the "Strategy for Realizing Next-Generation Information and Communication Infrastructure to Support AI Society - Beyond 5G Promotion Strategy 2.0 -" promoted by Japan’s Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications.

APN is expected to be deployed globally as a foundational network technology for next-generation services, including physical AI, because it enables high-capacity, low-latency, and energy-efficient communications and supports real-time processing of data obtained from sensors and robots in remote locations.

sourceContent.headline: 【解説】アドフラウド対策が進まない理由｜総務省が書いた指標悪化のジレンマ
sourceContent.description: 広告のクリックは増えたのに売上が動かない。HUMAN Securityが公表した広告不正5件のうち4件は、HTML5のゲーム・ニュース系サイトを換金先に使っていました。日本では対策をすると見かけの数字が下がるため動きにくいという声があり、総務省はこのジレンマを2025年のガイダンスに記しています。
paragraphs: Spider Labsが公表した「アドフラウド調査レポート（通年版2026）」によれば、AI最適化メニューの配信量はこの1年強で192%へ、すなわち約1.92倍に成長し、大手配信プラットフォームのAI最適化キャンペーンでは不正率が最大5.2%に達していました。
同社は、平均発生率自体は微減した一方、広告市場の拡大によって推定被害総額が増えたと説明しています。
読売新聞オンラインの報道によれば、フラワーギフト大手の花キューピットは、2025年の母の日商戦でクリック数が数百万回に達し、例年より約1割多い水準になりました。

summaryLines: Spider Labs가 공표한 「어드프라우드 조사 리포트(통년판 2026)」에 의하면, AI 최적화 메뉴의 전달량은 지난 1년 강으로 192%로, 즉 약 1.92배로 성장해, 대기업 배포 플랫폼의 AI 최적화 캠페인에서는 부정률이 최대 5.2%에 이르렀음
이 회사는 평균 발생률 자체가 줄어들었지만 광고 시장 확대로 예상 피해 총액이 증가했다고 설명함
요미우리 신문 온라인 보도에 의하면, 꽃 선물 대기업의 꽃 큐피트는, 2025년의 어머니의 일상전에서 클릭수가 수백만회에 달해, 예년보다 약 1할 많은 수준이 됨

sourceContent.headline: AI-Powered Banking: The Intelligence Revolution Reshaping BFSI — And the Talent Race Behind It
sourceContent.description: Picture a Monday morning at a mid-sized private bank. A loan officer logs in and reviews five credit applications — but before she reads a single line, an AI model has already scored each borrower using 400+ data signals, flagged two anomalies in transaction history, and cross-referenced all five against AML watchlists. Down the hall, the fraud team hasn't been alerted once today — not because fraud stopped, but because the system intercepted suspicious transactions overnight and blocked them before a single rupee moved.
paragraphs: An important aspect is that AI adoption in BFSI is no longer purely a technology or talent discussion.
Hiring the right talent is essential, but embedding AI into the operating model is where the real transformation begins.
The institutions that will realize the greatest value are those that redesign processes, strengthen governance, and build trust in AI-assisted decision-making.

feed.desc: [News] Chip Packaging Experts Flag Heat as AI’s Biggest Bottleneck; AI-Driven Design, CPO and STCO May Help    TrendForce

sourceContent.headline: [News] Chip Packaging Experts Flag Heat as AI’s Biggest Bottleneck; AI-Driven Design, CPO and STCO May Help
sourceContent.description: Heat is emerging as one of the biggest bottlenecks for AI infrastructure, prompting industry experts to argue that AI itself could become part of the ...
paragraphs: Liquid Cooling Becomes Standard for High-End AI Infrastructure, with Penetration Expected to Reach 53% in 2026, Says TrendForce [News] Samsung, SK hynix Plan New Heat Dissipation Technologies Starting HBM5: Three Memory Makers’ Approaches in Focus
TrendForce notes that thermal design power (TDP) for individual AI chips from NVIDIA, AMD, and Google has surpassed 1 kW, while rack-scale systems now consume hundreds of kilowatts.

According to Reuters , Samsung’s zHBM stacks memory vertically above AI accelerators, with its wafer-bonding technology expected to deliver over 10× the memory density of HBM5, 3× the energy efficiency, and more than 50% lower thermal resistance.

Heat is emerging as one of the biggest bottlenecks for AI infrastructure, prompting industry experts to argue that AI itself could become part of the solution. According to ETNews , KAIST Professor Kim Joung-ho warned that growing thermal challenges could constrain AI expansion as both system semiconductors and memory increasingly adopt three-dimensional (3D) stacking. The report highlights AI-based design automation and digital twin technologies as potential tools for reducing heat and power consumption across AI infrastructure.

Memory could become particularly challenging as stacking increases. Beyond HBM, which stacks DRAM, Kim expects HBF based on stacked NAND flash and HBS based on stacked SRAM to emerge as next-generation memory technologies for the AI era, the report adds. As these architectures become increasingly complex, he stressed that thermal management will require new approaches, particularly AI-driven design automation.

Kim cited an “HBM Design AI Agent” currently used in his laboratory as an example, noting that AI could help optimize structures for heat dissipation. According to the report, he called for AI design tools capable of autonomously handling increasingly complex packaging designs and identifying optimal solutions based on physical laws, alongside the development of high-heat-dissipation architectures.

feed.title: Goldman studied where AI is squeezing labor markets. Here's what it found
feed.desc: Goldman studied where AI is squeezing labor markets. Here's what it found    CNBC

sourceContent.headline: Goldman studied where AI is squeezing labor markets. Here's what it found
sourceContent.description: Goldman Sachs found that AI is starting to weigh on employment across developed economies.
paragraphs: Goldman combined 11 surveys measuring AI adoption across countries and found that major developed markets have adoption rates of roughly 15% to 20%.
The labor market impact comes as AI adoption is spreading across developed economies.
Employment in the industry is now below trend in the U.S., 39% lower, Canada, down 33%, and Germany 27% below trend, according to the report.
Entry-level workers appear particularly exposed to the impact of AI adoption on employment.
AI adoption is already widespread across developed economies, averaging roughly 15% to 20%.
Artificial intelligence is starting to weigh on labor market across major developed economies, with effects varying across industries and seniority levels, according to Goldman Sachs.

summaryLines: Goldman은 국가 전체의 AI 채택을 측정하는 11개 설문 조사를 종합하여 주요 선진국 시장의 채택률이 대략 15%~20%인 것으로 나타남

feed.desc: KISDI, AI 고노출 산업서 저임금 고용 둔화·임금 불평등 확대 경향    중부매일

sourceContent.headline: KISDI, AI 고노출 산업서 저임금 고용 둔화·임금 불평등 확대 경향
paragraphs: AI 노출도가 0.1포인트 높을수록 상위 10%와 하위 10% 임금 격차(P90/P10)의 증가율이 8.13%p 높았다.
19일 연구원에 따르면 보고서는 국가데이터처 지역별 고용 조사를 활용해 217개 산업 소분류를 대상으로 2013~2023년 변화를 분석했다.
［중부매일 김정기 기자］ 충북혁신도시(진천군 덕산읍)에 있는 정보통신정책연구원(KISDI)이 발간한 ‘프리미엄 리포트 26-7’에서 AI 노출이 임금 불평등에 미치는 영향을 산업 수준에서 실증 분석했다.
다만 고용 총량에 뚜렷한 변화가 없어도 임금 수준과 분배 측면에서 영향이 나타날 수 있는데, 관련 실증 근거는 아직 제한적이고 연구 결과도 엇갈린다.

sourceContent.headline: Singapore ranked first in Counterpoint Research’s 2025 Global AI Cities Index, ahead of Seoul, Beijing and San Francisco — remarkable for a country less than half the size of Greater London that is home to operations from 80 of the world’s top 100 technology firms.
sourceContent.description: Singapore topped a 100-city AI adoption index by combining government programmes, corporate density, talent and infrastructure inside an area under half Greater London’s size.
paragraphs: At the end of 2025, the entire country covered 744.3 square kilometres, a little over 47 percent of Greater London’s area.
Singapore built machinery for turning strategy into projects Singapore launched its first national AI strategy in 2019 and National AI Strategy 2.0 in December 2023 .
It does not mean 80 of those companies were founded in Singapore, moved their principal headquarters there or operate a large AI research laboratory in the country.

sourceContent.headline: KISDI "AI 노출도 높은 산업일수록 임금 불평등 확대"
sourceContent.description: 정보통신정책연구원(KISDI) 본사 전경. KISDI 제공 [파이낸셜뉴스] 인공지능(AI) 노출도가 높은 산업일수록 임금 분포의 양극단을 중심으로 산업 내 임금 불평등이 확대되는 경향이 나타난다는 분석이 나왔다. AI 고노출 산업의 임금 프리미엄이 확대되면서 AI 노출 수준에 따른 산업 간 임금 격차도 확대될 가능성이 있다는 의견도 제기
paragraphs: 19일 정보통신정책연구원(KISDI)이 발간한 'AI 노출과 임금 불평등: 산업 수준의 실증분석' 보고서에 따르면 모든 통제변수를 포함한 분석에서 AI 노출도가 0.1p 높은 산업은 상위 10%와 하위 10% 근로자 간 임금 격차를 나타내는 P90/P10 배율의 증가율이 8.13%p 높게 나타났다.
실시간 트렌드 데이터는 안정화 기간 중 베타(Beta) 서비스로 운영하며, 01:00~06:00에는 데이터 수집 규모와 이용률이 낮아 제한적으로 제공합니다.
이는 국가데이터처 지역별 고용조사를 활용해 임금 분포 산출이 가능한 217개 산업 소분류를 대상으로 AI 확산 이전인 2013년과 2023년 사이의 변화를 분석한 결과다.
인공지능(AI) 노출도가 높은 산업일수록 임금 분포의 양극단을 중심으로 산업 내 임금 불평등이 확대되는 경향이 나타난다는 분석이 나왔다.
(예시) 가장 빠른 뉴스가 있고 다양한 정보, 쌍방향 소통이 숨쉬는 다음뉴스를 만나보세요. 다음뉴스는 국내외 주요이슈와 실시간 속보, 문화생활 및 다양한 분야의 뉴스를 입체적으로 전달하고 있습니다.
sourceContent.text:
19일 정보통신정책연구원(KISDI)이 발간한 'AI 노출과 임금 불평등: 산업 수준의 실증분석' 보고서에 따르면 모든 통제변수를 포함한 분석에서 AI 노출도가 0.1p 높은 산업은 상위 10%와 하위 10% 근로자 간 임금 격차를 나타내는 P90/P10 배율의 증가율이 8.13%p 높게 나타났다.

실시간 트렌드 데이터는 안정화 기간 중 베타(Beta) 서비스로 운영하며, 01:00~06:00에는 데이터 수집 규모와 이용률이 낮아 제한적으로 제공합니다.

이는 국가데이터처 지역별 고용조사를 활용해 임금 분포 산출이 가능한 217개 산업 소분류를 대상으로 AI 확산 이전인 2013년과 2023년 사이의 변화를 분석한 결과다.

인공지능(AI) 노출도가 높은 산업일수록 임금 분포의 양극단을 중심으로 산업 내 임금 불평등이 확대되는 경향이 나타난다는 분석이 나왔다.

(예시) 가장 빠른 뉴스가 있고 다양한 정보, 쌍방향 소통이 숨쉬는 다음뉴스를 만나보세요. 다음뉴스는 국내외 주요이슈와 실시간 속보, 문화생활 및 다양한 분야의 뉴스를 입체적으로 전달하고 있습니다.

sourceLines: 19일 정보통신정책연구원(KISDI)이 발간한 'AI 노출과 임금 불평등: 산업 수준의 실증분석' 보고서에 따르면 모든 통제변수를 포함한 분석에서 AI 노출도가 0.1p 높은 산업은 상위 10%와 하위 10% 근로자 간 임금 격차를 나타내는 P90/P10 배율의 증가율이 8.13%p 높게 나타났다.
실시간 트렌드 데이터는 안정화 기간 중 베타(Beta) 서비스로 운영하며, 01:00~06:00에는 데이터 수집 규모와 이용률이 낮아 제한적으로 제공합니다.
이는 국가데이터처 지역별 고용조사를 활용해 임금 분포 산출이 가능한 217개 산업 소분류를 대상으로 AI 확산 이전인 2013년과 2023년 사이의 변화를 분석한 결과다.

feed.title: Goldman Sachs Sees Limited Evidence AI Spending Is Crowding Out Other Investment
feed.desc: Goldman Sachs Sees Limited Evidence AI Spending Is Crowding Out Other Investment    Yahoo Finance
feed.titleEn: Goldman Sachs Sees Limited Evidence AI Spending Is Crowding Out Other Investment
feed.descEn: Goldman Sachs says the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence investment in the United States could be starting to displace spending elsewhere in the economy, although the bank has found relatively little evidence of a widespread crowding-out effect so far. With AI-related investment approaching hundreds of billions of dollars annually, analysts are increasingly examining whether the boom is diverting capital, construction resources and financing away from other business activities.
summaryLinesEn: Goldman Sachs analyst Jessica Rindels estimates that U.S. investment in artificial intelligence will reach almost $600 billion in 2026, "equivalent to nearly 2% of US GDP."

That issue is particularly relevant because a significant portion of AI spending is directed towards imported technology equipment, potentially limiting the amount of investment that translates directly into domestic economic activity.

Goldman Sachs says the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence investment in the United States could be starting to displace spending elsewhere in the economy, although the bank has found relatively little evidence of a widespread crowding-out effect so far.

feed.title: The Tablet Market Hits a Wall
feed.desc: The Tablet Market Hits a Wall    IDC | Trusted Tech Intelligence

sourceContent.headline: The Tablet Market Hits a Wall
sourceContent.description: Memory-driven price hikes just drove tablet shipments down 12.3% YoY. IDC's Q2 2026 Tracker data shows where demand is holding and what vendors do next.
paragraphs: A Brutal Quarter, and a Bigger Question About Relevance Worldwide tablet shipments fell to 33.6 million units in the second quarter of 2026, down 5.2% from the prior quarter and 12.3% from a year ago , according to IDC’s Worldwide Quarterly Personal Computing Device Tracker .
IDC’s own PCD Forecast Assumptions had already flagged this inflection point across two consecutive quarterly cycles, projecting shipment declines accelerating from 2026Q2 onward.
Worldwide tablet shipments fell 5.2% QoQ and 12.3% YoY in Q2 2026, the category’s steepest YoY decline this cycle, driven by the memory (DRAM/NAND) supply shortage.

feed.title: US-China AI trade decoupling ‘manageable’ – but tech curbs a ‘wild card’: Citi
feed.desc: US-China AI trade decoupling ‘manageable’ – but tech curbs a ‘wild card’: Citi    South China Morning Post

sourceContent.headline: US-China AI trade decoupling ‘manageable’ – but tech curbs a ‘wild card’: Citi
sourceContent.description: Beijing can weather current trade friction but tightening restrictions on open-weight models complicate outlook, analysts say.
paragraphs: The US-China direct bilateral AI trade has largely decoupled – with Chinese AI-related exports to the US falling 4.1 per cent year on year between January and June, shaving 0.5 percentage points off overall export growth – and Citi analysts noted that China remained an indirect beneficiary of the broader global AI boom.
The analysts estimated that a full AI decoupling, considered an extreme-case scenario, could place up to 9.2 per cent of China’s exports at risk.

Beijing can weather current trade friction but tightening restrictions on open-weight models complicate outlook, analysts say As US-China tech tensions rise ahead of an expected leadership summit next month, analysts argue Washington’s latest restrictions are unlikely to cause a major disruption in China’s AI exports.

feed.titleEn: Supply Chain AI Deployed by 88%, Governed by 12%: IDC Finds Trust Is Real Barrier
feed.descEn: Supply chain AI governance lags far behind deployment: a 2,000-leader IDC study finds only 12% of supply chain organizations have embedded governance, while 41% expect to operate as fully autonomous
summaryLinesEn: The survey, which covered more than 2,000 supply chain leaders across nine global markets, found that only 12% of organizations have AI planning governance fully embedded in their operations — while 41% expect autonomous AI to become their core operating model within one to two years.

A new IDC study released Wednesday found that 88% of supply chain organizations have deployed AI but lack the governance infrastructure to oversee it responsibly — a gap made urgent by an approaching regulatory hard stop: the EU AI Act's full compliance obligations for high-risk AI systems take effect December 2, 2027, and most operators have barely started.

EU Act's December 2027 Deadline: Sixteen Months and Counting The EU AI Omnibus, which entered force July 27, 2026, extended compliance for standalone Annex III high-risk AI systems from the original August 2, 2026 date to December 2, 2027 — giving supply chain operators additional runway but not eliminating the obligation.

feed.desc: RBC wins IDC CIO Awards Canada 2026 for AI-driven credit underwriting transformation    Yahoo Finance
feed.titleEn: RBC wins IDC CIO Awards Canada 2026 for AI-driven credit underwriting transformation
feed.descEn: Royal Bank of Canada (TSX: RY) (NYSE: RY) has been named an IDC CIO Awards Canada 2026 winner for retail credit underwriting, an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted digital transformation program. The initiative is one of several that will help achieve the organization's bold ambition to generate $700 million to $1 billion in enterprise value from AI benefits by 2027.
summaryLinesEn: As Canada's biggest bank and one of the largest in the world, based on market capitalization, we have a diversified business model with a focus on innovation and providing exceptional experiences to our more than 19 million clients in Canada, the U.S. and 27 other countries.
The initiative is one of several that will help achieve the organization's bold ambition to generate $700 million to $1 billion in enterprise value from AI benefits by 2027.
Early results from the program, which enables the bank to look beyond traditional credit models, include improved approval rates, accelerated decision timelines and increased client acquisition.

feed.title: New Research from IDC Finds a Supply Chain AI “Accountability Gap”
feed.desc: New Research from IDC Finds a Supply Chain AI “Accountability Gap”    Supply Chain Digest

sourceContent.headline: New Research from IDC Finds a Supply Chain AI “Accountability Gap”
paragraphs: The IDC InfoBrief, which surveyed more than 2,000 supply chain leaders across nine global markets, found that while AI adoption is nearly universal - only 2% of respondents report no AI-enabled capabilities, and just 12% consider themselves AI leaders.
Roles will shift, not shrink. 79% see AI as an opportunity over threat, and partners with AI plus supply chain depth will win.

The research also points to a sharp acceleration in expectations for autonomous decision-making: just 6% of respondents describe their supply chains as autonomous at scale today, but 41% expect that to become their core operating model within one to two years - even though only 1 in 8 organizations has governance fully embedded to support it.

feed.title: GCCs Are Mistaking AI Adoption for AI Advantage
feed.desc: GCCs Are Mistaking AI Adoption for AI Advantage    Nasscom
feed.titleEn: GCCs Are Mistaking AI Adoption for AI Advantage
feed.descEn: By Vagesha Sinha, AVP – GCC Practice
summaryLinesEn: The bottleneck is no longer AI adoption but it is industry’s habit of treating visible AI activity as proof of enterprise advantage.
Advantage shows up when a GCC can prove that its data moved a recurring business decision faster, better, or more profitably than before.
According to AI-first Global Capability Centers Index 2026 , AI is used by almost all surveyed Indian GCCs, yet meaningful business impact remains elusive for nearly two-thirds of the industry.

localization.title: GCC는 AI 채택을 AI 이점으로 착각하고 있음
summaryLines: 병목 현상은 더 이상 AI 채택이 아니라 가시적인 AI 활동을 기업 이점의 증거로 간주하는 업계의 습관임
장점은 GCC가 데이터가 반복적인 비즈니스 결정을 이전보다 더 빠르고, 더 좋게, 더 수익성 있게 움직였다는 것을 증명할 수 있을 때 나타남
AI 우선 글로벌 역량 센터 지수 2026에 따르면 조사 대상 인도 GCC의 거의 모든 곳에서 AI를 사용하고 있지만 업계의 약 2/3에서는 여전히 의미 있는 비즈니스 영향을 파악하기 어렵음

feed.titleEn: KISDI, AI 생성물 표시의무 등 AI기본법 실효성 논의
feed.descEn: 정보통신정책연구원(KISDI) 전경. KISDI 제공 [파이낸셜뉴스] 정보통신정책연구원(KISDI)은 과학기술정보통신부와 오는 14일 서울 광화문 HJ 비즈니스센터에서 '인공지능(AI) 사회정책 포럼 기술·규범 분과' 제1차 회의를 개최한다고 12일 밝혔다. 이번 회의에서는 AI 생성물 표시 의무의 적용 대상의 유통 단계 확대 여부와,
summaryLinesEn: 정보통신정책연구원(KISDI)은 과학기술정보통신부와 오는 14일 서울 광화문 HJ 비즈니스센터에서 '인공지능(AI) 사회정책 포럼 기술·규범 분과' 제1차 회의를 개최한다고 12일 밝혔다.
"스토커 아냐" vs "연락 과도하게 많아"…檢, '황정민 스토킹 혐의' 여성에 벌금 1000만원 구형 실시간 트렌드 데이터는 안정화 기간 중 베타(Beta) 서비스로 운영하며, 01:00~06:00에는 데이터 수집 규모와 이용률이 낮아 제한적으로 제공합니다.
지상파 방송 3사는 지난해 1월 네이버를, 올해 2월에는 오픈AI를 상대로 뉴스 콘텐츠 무단 학습을 이유로 저작권 침해 소송을 제기했으며, 한국신문협회는 공정거래위원회에 관련 사건을 신고한 바 있다.

paragraphs: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs said the surge in artificial intelligence spending may be crowding out other business activity, though it found only limited evidence of that effect so far.
Rindels believes the rapid growth raises the question of whether it is displacing other spending, particularly because so much AI outlay goes on imported technology goods.

paragraphs: The Focus Group on Costing Models for Affordable Data Services (FG-CD) concluded its work with the adoption of four technical reports focused on promoting more equitable access to digital services globally.

SG3 also agreed on technical reports addressing the economic and policy frameworks associated with network slicing, a technology that enables multiple virtual networks to operate on shared physical infrastructure.

Egypt has chaired the latest meeting of the International Telecommunication Union’s Telecommunication Standardization Sector (ITU-T) Study Group 3 (SG3), which examined economic, financial and policy issues shaping the global digital economy.

summaryLines: FG-CD(Focus Group on Costing Models for Affordable Data Services)는 전 세계적으로 디지털 서비스에 대한 보다 공평한 접근을 촉진하는 데 초점을 맞춘 4가지 기술 보고서를 채택하는 것으로 작업을 마무리함
SG3는 또한 여러 가상 네트워크가 공유된 물리적 인프라에서 작동할 수 있게 하는 기술인 네트워크 슬라이싱과 관련된 경제 및 정책 프레임워크를 다루는 기술 보고서에 동의함
이집트는 글로벌 디지털 경제를 형성하는 경제, 금융 및 정책 문제를 조사한 국제전기통신연합(International Telecommunication Union)의 전기통신 표준화 부문(ITU-T) 연구 그룹 3(SG3)의 최근 회의를 의장으로 맡았음

sourceContent.headline: Citi Recommends Buying the Dip in Memory Stocks as AI Cycle Gains Momentum
sourceContent.description: Citi believes the recent sell-off in memory chip stocks presents a buying opportunity, arguing that the artificial intelligence-driven memory cycle is still in its early phases and could ultimately exceed the industry’s previous boom between 2001 and 2007. The bank says the current environment shares many similarities with the long NAND expansion seen during the early 2000s, when products such as MP3 players and digital cameras transformed demand and flash memory steadily replaced older storage
paragraphs: The bank said the current cycle "is likely to outperform the '01–'07 upcycle given that AI demand is driving both DRAM and NAND demand."
The bank estimates total HBM capacity per AI system will increase by 434%, rising from 20.7 terabytes to 110.6 terabytes as the number of GPUs per system grows from 72 to 576.

feed.title: Global AI Investment Is Forecast to Exceed $1 Trillion in 2026
feed.desc: Global AI Investment Is Forecast to Exceed $1 Trillion in 2026    Goldman Sachs
feed.titleEn: Global AI Investment Is Forecast to Exceed $1 Trillion in 2026
feed.descEn: Goldman Sachs Research adjusted widely cited measures of capital expenditure by US hyperscale tech companies to develop a more comprehensive estimate of AI investment around the world.
summaryLinesEn: That projection points to $1 trillion of AI-related investment around the globe in 2026, including $581 billion in the US, writes Joseph Briggs, who co-leads the Global Economics team, in a report.
There is also some risk of double-counting capex for AI for some companies that do not report property, plant, and equipment investment separately from financial leases in their capex statements.

Those estimates imply that AI capex will rise from 1.8% of GDP in the US (with global AI investment totaling 0.9% of global GDP) in 2026 to 2.5% of GDP in the US (1.3% globally) in 2027, with a further increase to 2.8% (1.4% globally) in 2028.

There is also some risk of double-counting capex for AI for some companies that do not report property, plant, and equipment investment separately from financial leases in their capex statements.

Those estimates imply that AI capex will rise from 1.8% of GDP in the US (with global AI investment totaling 0.9% of global GDP) in 2026 to 2.5% of GDP in the US (1.3% globally) in 2027, with a further increase to 2.8% (1.4% globally) in 2028.

feed.desc: Bank of America’s ‘Robust’ AI Data Center Deal Pipeline: Q&A    BloombergNEF
feed.titleEn: Bank of America’s ‘Robust’ AI Data Center Deal Pipeline: Q and A | BloombergNEF
feed.descEn: Bank of America says AI infrastructure financing remains robust as demand grows across data centers, power and compute.
summaryLinesEn: Bank of America has a “robust” pipeline across the three key pillars of data center development – buildings, power supply and compute equipment – according to Karen Fang, global head of infrastructure and sustainable finance.
For example, AI training tasks can be shifted to regions experiencing surplus renewable generation and scaled back in areas facing power constraints.

Over time, improved efficiency could reduce the need for additional power generation capacity, lower operating costs, and help address community concerns about the energy footprint of large-scale data center projects.

localization.title: Bank of America의 '강력한' AI 데이터 센터 딜 파이프라인 · Q&A | 블룸버그NEF
summaryLines: 인프라 및 지속 가능한 금융 부문 글로벌 책임자인 Karen Fang에 따르면 Bank of America는 데이터 센터 개발의 세 가지 주요 기둥인 건물, 전원 공급 장치 및 컴퓨팅 장비에 걸쳐 "강력한" 파이프라인을 보유하고 있음
예를 들어, AI 교육 작업은 잉여 재생 가능 발전이 있는 지역으로 이전되고 전력 제약이 있는 지역에서는 축소될 수 있음
시간이 지남에 따라 효율성이 향상되면 추가 발전 용량의 필요성이 줄어들고, 운영 비용이 낮아지며, 대규모 데이터 센터 프로젝트의 에너지 사용량에 대한 지역 사회의 우려를 해결하는 데 도움이 될 수 있음

feed.title: Runtime: Bank of America's CTIO on AI costs and a big shakeup for Google AI
feed.desc: Runtime: Bank of America's CTIO on AI costs and a big shakeup for Google AI    thestack.technology
feed.titleEn: Runtime: Bank of America's CTIO on AI costs and a big shakeup for Google AI
feed.descEn: + "Tokenomics" is here, AMD rises then falls, and SpaceXAI reveals AI revenue figures for the first time.
summaryLinesEn: That's a 213% jump since the previous quarter, and driven largely by the big compute deal it signed with Anthropic that was a big part of its $1.6 billion in revenue from "AI infrastructure."

A pragmatist with a $14b budget: The Stack sat down with Bank of America’s chief technology and information officer Hari Gopalkrishnan at the bank's London office to discuss his measured approach to the current agent madness (“People are going a little crazy”), as well as going into detail about revamping the bank’s AI chatbot Erica to be more cost-effective, and his platform plans.

We're convening in London on November 4-5, for a series of exclusive workshops and fireside conversations on the rise of BYOC as a favoured enterprise SaaS deployment model; how many CDOs are consolidating their data estates with Apache Iceberg; how CISOs at FTSE 100 scale are handling supply chain risk (with GSK's CISO) and more.

feed.title: Windows 11 will run better because of the Apple effect, says IDC
feed.desc: Windows 11 will run better because of the Apple effect, says IDC    Windows Latest

sourceContent.headline: Windows 11 will run better because of the Apple effect, says IDC
sourceContent.description: IDC says Apple's MacBook Neo is pressuring Microsoft to build a more efficient Windows 11, as PC shipments fall and RAM prices soar in 2026.
paragraphs: At least, it’s better than the absurdly priced Surface Laptop for Business with 8GB RAM selling for $1,299, more than double the Neo’s price!.

Two months after the MacBook Neo launched, a Microsoft-commissioned benchmark against the Neo found every OEM Windows machine tested shipped with double the RAM, more storage, and better port selection than Apple’s 8GB, 256GB, USB 2.0-bottlenecked machine.
Apple’s $599 MacBook Neo turned out to be the catalyst Microsoft needed to fix Windows 11, after years of gamers, IT admins, and everyday users complaining that the OS felt slower and heavier.

localization.title: IDC는 Apple 효과로 인해 Windows 11이 더 잘 작동할 것이라고 밝힘
summaryLines: 적어도 Neo 가격의 두 배 이상인 1,299달러에 판매되는 8GB RAM을 갖춘 터무니없는 가격의 기업용 Surface Laptop보다 낫음

Apple의 599달러 MacBook Neo는 수년간 게이머, IT 관리자 및 일반 사용자가 OS가 느리고 무거워졌다고 불평한 이후 Microsoft가 Windows 11을 수정하는 데 필요한 촉매제가 됨

feed.title: AI-First Enterprises: Trends and Emerging Directions
feed.desc: AI-First Enterprises: Trends and Emerging Directions    Nasscom
feed.titleEn: AI-First Enterprises: Trends and Emerging Directions
feed.descEn: Key Highlights AI spend is trending upward, decoupling from technology budget growth, as enterprises shift from AI preparedness to deployment at scale.
summaryLinesEn: It is reinforced by aggressive investment plans as 2-in-3 AI-first enterprises are increasing the AI spend growth rate in CY26 over and above that in CY25.

AI-first execution is shifting decisively from experimentation to industrialization. 3-in 4 AI-first enterprises have scaled-up PoCs as they work towards industrializing AI with better AI technology selection, architectural integration, builder and enablement talent, and the focus on scaling intelligence over use cases.
AI-first strategy is shifting from cost optimization to customer-centric growth.

정보통신정책연구원(KISDI)은 지난달 말 전국 초·중·고 교사를 대상으로 'AI 윤리 수업 실습 연수 챌린지 페스타'를 개최했다고 5일 밝혔다.

feed.desc: US Market Pulse August 2026    Goldman Sachs Asset Management
feed.titleEn: US Market Pulse August 2026
feed.descEn: The Market Pulse highlights the latest market developments and trends, coupled with insights on portfolio construction.
summaryLinesEn: In the US, we expect core inflation closer to 3% in December 2026 given the effects of tariffs, energy prices, and AI measurement issues, with it falling closer to 2% in 2027 as those subside.
We estimate that over time 7% of jobs are likely to be displaced, but leading AI labs have suggested that the technology can do just 2-3% of all jobs today.

Significant AI capex requires a mix of financing, with hyperscaler issuance accounting for 16-23% of gross issuance in USD IG, HY, and leveraged loan markets YTD, and a growing share of non-USD and private markets as well.

localization.title: 2026년 8월 미국 시장 동향
summaryLines: 미국에서는 관세, 에너지 가격, AI 측정 문제의 영향을 고려할 때 2026년 12월 근원 인플레이션이 3%에 가까워질 것으로 예상하고, 이러한 요인이 가라앉으면서 2027년에는 2%에 가까워질 것으로 예상됨
우리는 시간이 지남에 따라 일자리의 7%가 대체될 가능성이 있다고 추정하지만, 주요 AI 연구소에서는 현재 이 기술이 전체 일자리의 2~3%만 수행할 수 있다고 제안함
상당한 AI 투자에는 하이퍼스케일러 발행이 USD IG, HY 및 레버리지 대출 시장 YTD에서 총 발행의 16~23%를 차지하고 비 USD 및 민간 시장의 점유율도 증가하는 등 혼합 자금 조달이 필요함

feed.title: From Cloud First to AI First: Why Infrastructure Is Now the Decisive Battleground
feed.desc: From Cloud First to AI First: Why Infrastructure Is Now the Decisive Battleground    Nasscom
feed.titleEn: From Cloud First to AI First: Why Infrastructure Is Now the Decisive Battleground
feed.descEn: For more than a decade, cloud‑first was the defining posture of enterprise technology leadership. It helped organizations unlock scale, flexibility, and speed at a time when digital transformation was primarily about modernization and cost efficiency. That era has now reached maturity. Today, we are at a far more consequential inflection point.
summaryLinesEn: Recent research into enterprise AI adoption reveals a striking paradox: the majority of generative AI initiatives stall before reaching production, and even fewer scale to deliver enterprise‑wide value.
The Productivity Paradox: Why AI Spending Isn’t Paying Off Across Fortune 100 organizations, AI investment is accelerating.

In an AI‑first enterprise, technology operations recede from executive attention, not because they are deprioritized, but because they perform with such consistency that they no longer demand intervention.

feed.descEn: ServetIA is an AI-powered research platform developed for the Spanish Prime Minister’s Office to help government staff conduct faster, more thorough policy rese...
summaryLinesEn: PresidencIA: Generative AI Adoption Programme for the Spanish Prime Minister’s Office Leveraging on 3 pillars (Community, Applications and Infrastructure), PresidencIA builds AI literacy among staff through workshops, community and best practices, develops custom AI tools for processes in the PM’s Office, and pursues on-premises AI infrastructure for tech sovereignty.

A specific programme for the development of AI skills (under development at the time of writing) will be launched as part of the national plan for digital competency enhancement (Plan Nacional de Competencias Digitales).
A study on the impact of AI use on vulnerable collectives was expected to be conducted in Q4 2024.

AI 사용이 취약한 집단에 미치는 영향에 대한 연구는 2024년 4분기에 수행될 것으로 예상됨
